name: memory_recall
description: Retrieves the complete knowledge profile for a single entity (type, summary, attributes, recent observations, and incoming/outgoing relations) so agents recover prior architectural context at task start, preventing duplicate discovery or broken invariants.

entity.description: Specifies the case-insensitive entity name to recall (1-200 characters) so the matching graph node and its attached observations are loaded, preventing ambiguous entity lookups.

category.description: Filters the entity's returned observations to a single category (such as invariant, decision, or architecture) so recall focuses on the requested concern, preventing irrelevant observation noise.

session_id.description: Filters the entity's returned observations to a specific session label so workflow-specific facts can be inspected, preventing cross-session clutter.

limit.description: Caps the maximum number of newest observations returned (1-100, default 20, setting has_more_observations=true when truncated so callers can re-call with limit=100 or use memory_search), preventing unbounded observation payloads.

relation_limit.description: Caps the maximum number of incoming and outgoing relations returned per direction (1-100, default 50, setting has_more_outgoing_relations or has_more_incoming_relations when truncated so callers can re-call with relation_limit=100), preventing unbounded graph edge payloads.
